turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
"Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so tell me what you think Owen did."
The checker said 94 percent. That's the end of it.
"A machine's guess. Even the company that sells that checker says not to use it as the only basis for punishing a student. So what else do you have?"
I don't need more proof than that.
"Then you're going to lose this in front of the principal. Is there a document, Hale, or is 94 percent all there is?"
The software doesn't lie, unlike some people.
"Are you calling me a liar? Or my son? Say which one, and say it plainly."
"Procedure 4.2 says you call a parent before any mark is entered. Nobody called me. Owen saw the zero on his phone in the middle of class. Did you break that rule, Hale?"
